lead_story.title: eToro aims to boost US profile in $231M TradeZero deal
lead_story.summary: The Israeli platform wants to harness TradeZero’s “highly engaged” community to forge “a faster path to launching new products” stateside.

top_stories.title: Bank of America pledges $250B toward US infrastructure update
top_stories.summary: BofA will lend, bank, invest in and advise on projects such as data centers, power generation and transportation.

top_stories.title: Goldman Sachs to buy ETF provider NEOS for up to $2.25B
top_stories.summary: Expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, the deal is the bank’s second multibillion-dollar ETF-related acquisition of the past nine months.

top_stories.title: Regions Bank names next chief administrative officer
top_stories.summary: Kate Danella, the bank’s head of consumer banking, will succeed Dave Keenan, who will retire at the end of the year, the Alabama-based lender said.

top_stories.title: Louisiana bank agrees to FDIC consent order over credit quality
top_stories.summary: Regulators restricted First Guaranty Bank’s ability to extend credit to borrowers whose transactions were labeled a “loss” in a September 2025 exam. The bank also must boost its Tier 1 leverage capital ratio.

top_stories.title: Illinois’ HBT to buy in-state Tri-County Financial for $204.6M
top_stories.summary: The deal, set to close in the first quarter of 2027, would boost HBT’s footprint to more than 100 branches and its assets past $8 billion.

lead_story.title: Florida hedge fund’s ex-CFO pleads guilty in $3M embezzlement case
lead_story.summary: Theodore Woo, who is accused of misappropriating money from the fund for his own personal uses, has pleaded guilty to one count of securities fraud.

top_stories.title: How the Brooklyn Nets CFO is measuring returns on AI
top_stories.summary: Peter Stern, who runs finance for the Nets, New York Liberty and Barclays Center, discusses AI use, the changing business of sports and why he spends time teaching finance to incarcerated people.

top_stories.title: How to cut credit approval time without raising risk: Metric of the Month
top_stories.summary: Faster decisions require clearer thresholds, better intake and disciplined risk review.

top_stories.title: New Jersey township CFO charged with theft by deception
top_stories.summary: Cameron Keng, finance chief of Franklin Township, has been charged following a local bank’s discovery of an alleged double-billing plot.

top_stories.title: HCA Healthcare’s former CFO on the role of partnerships in health
top_stories.summary: Bill Rutherford, who served on the finance team of the Tennessee-based healthcare giant for decades, reflects on his career in health as he switches to board service in retirement.

top_stories.title: Why does your AI keep getting the numbers wrong?
top_stories.summary: The finance teams getting real value from AI know their data is bigger than any model and design around it.
